reviews.text:
Best dog daycare and hotel.
The staff LOVES animals and are experts in behavioral training.
They also have cameras so you can see your dog whenever you travel!

What would I do without you!

For a few months now, we've been bringing our almost 4-year-old French bulldog to this daycare/boutique hotel.
After a gradual introduction period, we left him for a night, then a weekend, then 4-5 days, and finally for a longer stay in August.
The staff are competent, responsible, and truly passionate about dogs.
They offer daycare and boarding services customized to the needs of each guest, alternating play and socialization with rest, walks, and cognitive stimulation.
They provide constant information and updates with photos and videos.
We've always felt comfortable and confident that our dog is in loving and competent hands.
Highly recommended.

A unique experience for a 5-star dog hotel where you can truly feel safe and at ease leaving your beloved four-legged friend. The transition is more or less like a daycare center for our children, but that's how it should be to avoid hurting our beloved pets. Our dog probably won't be so happy to return home after staying at this super boarding facility.

In the middle of a complicated process of relocating to another country, we had to leave our dog in Italy to complete a quarantine, and the best decision we made was leaving him at Spazio Super Dog.

Cookie is not an easy dog, but over time he learned to trust everyone and to love his routine there — and that says a lot about the place.

We had three peaceful months, receiving daily updates and photos of him looking completely happy.

Even from the other side of the world, you can truly feel the love and care the girls have for the animals.

I fully recommend them, and I would give a thousand stars if I could.
They are wonderful with my dachshund…He is always excited to go so I know he has a great time!

For me, the quality of service is expressed in seeing my dog ​​happy and enthusiastic every time we visit. Knowing that he feels at ease and welcomed here gives me great peace of mind. I thank the staff for being attentive and professional!

Have you ever seen dachshunds scratching at the door to be dropped off at boarding without looking back?!
We feel very comfortable when our basses are at Sapzio Superdog, whether for daycare or boarding. The girls are wonderful, and the communication is excellent.
Highly recommended!
Professionalism and kindness towards our furry friends is what we expect from a reputable dog daycare.

My dog ​​has been going to this daycare practically every day for five months now and loves it. Every time she realizes we're coming, she starts running toward the entrance with joy. For me, it's the most beautiful confirmation there could be!!
The entire team is truly sweet, and you can clearly see how much they love dogs and how much they take care of them with care and affection. Even when I leave her for a few days, I always feel at ease knowing she's in good hands.
The way they treat dogs is something special and hard to find anywhere else. I trust them with my eyes closed and couldn't be happier with my choice. Highly recommended!!!

I always leave my 6-month-old puppy with the girls at Spazio Superdog, and I've never seen my Giulio so happy.
I'm constantly updated with photos and videos.
When I leave him to sleep for a few days, I can even see him via webcam.
A truly special place for dogs.
A place where you can leave your dogs in peace, the girls are prepared and affectionate and the dogs are happy

I've been bringing Ciro in for a few years now, and from day one, the staff has been welcoming, professional, and truly affectionate. Every time I drop him off, he wags his tail happily and runs up to the trainers with enthusiasm; to me, that's worth a thousand words.
The environment is clean, safe, and well-organized, with spaces dedicated to play, rest, and interaction with other dogs. I regularly receive updates and photos of his days, which makes me feel even more at ease when I'm away.
The 24-hour webcam service is fantastic.
It's clear that the animals here are treated with love, respect, and attention.
My bulldog sometimes doesn't eat right away, and they have the patience to stay with him and feed him (as you can see in the photo).
Ciro returns home happy and satisfied, and I'm grateful to have found a place where I can leave him with complete confidence.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for the best for their four-legged friend! 🐾❤️

Dear user, I see from your profile that you delight in reviewing all the one-star pet boarding facilities. I assume you've never been a customer of any of them. I think I can thank you on behalf of all the staff and our colleagues who own similar facilities for needlessly tarnishing the work and passion we put into the services we provide. Reviews like yours are of no use to us, much less to our customers.

We took our Thiago to boarding school in August, trying out the daycare first. What can I say? We're so happy! It's our first experience, and we've seen the puppy go to school and come back happy! The girls are very attentive and caring, we absolutely recommend it!

The Super Dog team gives us complete peace of mind when we have to leave our poodle, who always has so much fun. This is confirmed by the fact that when we return, he's always happy, whether it's for a long period (e.g., a week) or just a few days.

I would only entrust my dogs to them. We've been taking our puppies to this facility for two years now, and the dogs are happy and doing very well there. It's great that we get daily updates with photos and messages about what they're doing and eating. Highly recommended.
I've been going to the Super Dog space for years, and their experience, expertise, and kindness are my top priorities. I really enjoy it, and my Piuma is finally able to socialize.

For over a year now, Spazio Superdog has been the place where I can safely leave Max, knowing that he'll be in good hands with Zeudi and his team. I have no complaints, and in fact, I'd like to compliment you on how you manage the facility.

My girls love Superdog. The staff is very friendly, reliable, and they obviously love dogs. We use them mostly for one or two-night stays, and day care, however a couple times we left them for a week or more and they were always happy to come and go. They're great at sending photos, too. Highly recommended!
Every guest at Spazio Super Dog is treated like a prince! A charming place, 5 stars for cleanliness too.

We sometimes leave our dog at Spazio Hotel all day, and our Patty always can't wait to go back! She's never alone and socializes all day with her four-legged friends under the watchful eye of the staff 😁 …
Everything is great, my Penny is so happy and treated like a queen. Everyone who works there is knowledgeable and very loving with animals. I recommend them to everyone. 💚 …

My beloved dog Louis will be a regular visitor to this wonderful space again in 2025.
I once again congratulate Romina Capra and the entire staff for their professionalism and kindness. You are extraordinary.
A clean and safe place to leave your dog. My dog ​​wants to come in every time we walk by! That's all I need to say. Everything was perfect.
Excellent service
Fantastic

Spazio SuperDog is a guarantee for both dog owners and our four-legged friends: professionalism, experience, friendliness, and sweetness are the absolute protagonists.
Furthermore, the location in the city center yet just steps from the park is truly unique.

We've been entrusting our dog to the Spazio SuperDog staff for a long time. We feel at ease when Audrey is with them. Even more importantly, we see her enter the daycare center enthusiastically every time we bring her; since animals don't lie, it's definitely a sign of quality.

My little/beautiful furry friend has a truly difficult personality, but the wonderful welcome he receives at this daycare center is the key to his improvement day by day. When I drop him off in the morning, he explodes with joy at the sight of the daycare door and the caregiver who greets him. For me, who adores him, it's an incredible source of peace to know he's in these hands. In the time since I've been bringing him to this facility, I've seen new staff members emerge, but the common denominator has always been their extreme affection and tenderness towards our four-legged friends. It's therefore only right to compliment them on the care they take, including their staff selection. My little/big Tiberio and I are truly happy to have met them.
Definitely the best daycare/boarding in town! My French bulldog loves both the place and the staff! Highly recommended.

Very knowledgeable and helpful staff. My Maltipoo can't wait to go there, unlike the daycare I took him to before. His behavior doesn't lie!!! He goes crazy with joy as soon as he sees Zeudi or Romina :)

I started walking my dachshund when he was 4 months old. Even though he was so tiny, I felt comfortable watching him socialize safely, under the watchful eye of trained and attentive trainers. Four months later, he's so happy; he can't wait to come in, and when I take him back, he pulls to play again! I sometimes check their webcam while I'm at work and always see a playful and peaceful environment for all the dogs. Highly recommended!

Very highly recommended!  We arrived in Milano four years ago with our doodle and she has been in the safest and best possible hands with Romina ever since  Wonderful staff and facilities, they really love their dogs and it shows. Truffle is always super excited when she gets dropped off in the morning.   Thank you Romina!

I've been bringing my dog ​​here for years, and I can't wait to return every day!
The facility is very organized and clean.
The staff is professional and super helpful; you can immediately tell they love their job.
Perfect space for our dog who can't wait to go there every morning and play with her friends!

I've been attending Spazio SuperDog for over a year! My dogs, a Dalmatian and a Chiwi, are always happy to spend the day at the daycare, where they are cared for by very professional staff whom I trust!
During the day, I'm always kept informed of their activities through photos and messages!
Thank you so much everyone!

Spazio Dog is my Ziggy's second home 😍 I take him every day when I go to work and often on weekends when I travel. Ziggy is happy because he enjoys playing with the other dogs and receives lots of cuddles from the staff, who are truly knowledgeable and welcoming. In fact, if I happen to be walking in the area, Ziggy pulls me because he wants to go to Spazio Dog! Highly recommended by me and Ziggy with all my heart ❤️

A comfortable and reassuring daycare/hotel for owners and pets. The staff is attentive and very affectionate. It's a joy to bring my dachshund, who wags her tail happily as she approaches the facility. The environment is clean and very organized.
My super happy Vicky in SuperDog Space!!!!

Great professionals and well-kept spaces, my dogs are always very happy when they come to them. Having a 24-hour surveillance service with cameras, which I can access once or twice a day to see what my pups are up to, gives me peace of mind. I recommend them without hesitation.
The staff is very kind. I drop my dog ​​off regularly, and he's always happy to go!
If you love your furry friends, don't leave them in this shelter.
Nice and kind. My dog ​​Bruce came home happy and happy.

Vittoria and Zeudi truly love their work and especially their dogs.
My 5-month-old puppy has thrived both at the daycare and at the boarding facility, so much so that I've happily left him with them several times, being able to …
Kind and professional, the clean and welcoming environment took excellent care of my two furry friends. The ability to see them 24/7 via webcam is excellent, thanks to Zeudi and the entire team.
